summary: Iteration 4 testing: bulk exercise import, PDF/PPTX import-doc, Comparar page, PWA assets. Backend: 10/10 new tests pass (test_iteration4.py) covering POST /api/exercises/bulk with component keyword guessing, PPTX friendly 400 error (LibreOffice missing), PDF import creating exercises, unsupported format rejection, /manifest.json validation (theme_color #0C3B1E, 192+512 icons), and /apple-touch-icon.png, /icon-192.png, /icon-512.png, /sw.js all returning 200. Frontend: logged in as admin, verified nav-comparar tab present in menu, /comparar shows cmp-empty before selection, both cmp-select-a and cmp-select-b dropdowns list 8 goalkeepers with cmp-select-*-opt-<id> children, selecting one in each dropdown hides cmp-empty and renders cmp-stats table plus 5 comparative charts (Avaliações, Técnicas, Seguimento, Zona, Distância). Excludes selected GK from the other dropdown (A picked 1 → B shows 7). Caderno: import-exercises-btn opens import-dialog, pasted 3 lines into import-list-text with format 'Título | descrição | componentes' and clicking import-list-btn created 3 exercises (toast '3 exercício(s) criados.'), dialog closed, cards refreshed. Explicit components stay (Velocidade de reação, Agilidade+Coordenação); when omitted, backend guessed Ativação for 'aquecimento dinâmico geral' — confirmed via card badge. Test data cleaned up (Caderno back to 0). No blocking issues.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing `Description`/aria-describedby (a11y warning in console). Same warning also on exercise-dialog. Not blocking but easy fix: add <DialogDescription/> or aria-describedby to the DialogContent components.

action_items: Optional: silence Radix Dialog a11y warning by adding DialogDescription to import-dialog and exercise-dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:660 import-doc: heavy imports (pymupdf, subprocess, pptx) are done inside the handler which is fine, but base64-embedding whole PDF pages as PNG data URLs in DB (line 723-724) can blow up MongoDB doc size for larger PDFs. Consider storing images in GridFS or as separate files, and dpi=110 may still yield >100KB per slide.
server.py:613,619 update/delete_exercise use ObjectId(eid) without try/except — an invalid id yields a 500 instead of 404/400.

Caderno.js: parseList is case-insensitive against COMPONENTES but does not handle diacritics fully (e.g. 'reacao' won't match 'Velocidade de reação'). The backend `guess_components` already handles both forms — parseList could be simplified to just forward strings and let backend match, or normalize via unicode NFD before comparing.
Comparar.js is fine but every GK selection triggers a fresh /profile fetch even if the same GK was previously loaded (no caching). Not a bug, just wasteful.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 TEST_UI_* exercises during UI test; all cleaned up afterwards (Caderno back to 0 exercises as expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (iteration 1-3) + /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (new features). Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. PPTX import intentionally returns friendly 400 in PT because LibreOffice is not installed. Caderno starts with 0 exercises by design.
